title: RunInjectedCommand executor
description: Runs a shell command with environment variables that can be generated from scripts or read from artifact files.

inject.description: Array of environment variable specifications. Each item provides the env name and source (script or artifact).

command.description: Path to script file or shell command with redirection. Script output becomes the env var value.

artifact.description: Optional path where the script result should be saved as an artifact file

args.description: Optional array of arguments passed to the script

timeout.description: Maximum execution time in milliseconds for inject scripts (default 30000); when set, also caps the main command, otherwise the main command runs until it exits
